pair.description: Name the device and choose what it is used for. You’ll get a code and a QR to open on it.

pairing.title: Pair this device
pairing.step1: An admin opens Admin → Devices → Pair a device on another screen and gets a code.
pairing.step2: Install the Hub’s certificate on this device (below), so it can use the secure connection.
pairing.step3: Enter the code here (scanning the admin’s QR fills it in) and tap Pair.
pairing.certWhy: This page is open over plain HTTP. Installing the Hub’s certificate lets this device use the secure address, which Bluetooth and the camera need.
pairing.android2: Open Settings → Security & privacy → More security settings → Encryption & credentials.
pairing.android3: Tap Install a certificate → CA certificate → Install anyway, and choose the downloaded file.
pairing.android4: Check that the fingerprint below matches the one on the admin’s screen.
pairing.codeHint: 8 letters and digits, from the admin’s screen.
pairing.codeError: Enter the code shown on the admin’s screen.

pairing.nextFullScreen: It will now open as {kind}, full screen.
